slides.h: WE ASKED ANIMALS: WHAT'S YOUR [[RED FLAG]]?
slides.tease: **Five confessions.** The cat's is the last slide. It is not sorry.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.quote: I trust everyone instantly. Even the vacuum. We're good now.
slides.sub: Zero filters. Zero regrets. One bite incident (the vacuum started it).

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.quote: I walk into traffic like I own the road. Because I do.

slides.name: The Owl
slides.quote: I start every sentence with 'well, technically.'

slides.name: The Goldfish
slides.quote: I forget the argument mid... wait. Were we fighting?
slides.sub: Nine seconds of memory. Zero grudges. Undefeated.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.quote: I don't have red flags. I am the flag.

slides.body: Follow before the pigeon walks into your feed unsupervised.
